rationale.raw_award_count: Retired because buyer-driven publication, incomplete coverage, framework lot multiplication and notice-version behaviour prevent notice count from serving as a company-activity denominator.
rationale.buyer_breadth: May corroborate an externally established commercial breadth condition when entity resolution and buyer identity are complete; it cannot qualify one alone.
rationale.award_category_mix: May corroborate an externally established capability or investment theme only when category classification is usable and repeated; it cannot qualify one alone.
rationale.disclosed_contract_value: Values often describe framework ceilings, whole-lot values or multi-supplier totals and are frequently absent; preserve as source-qualified fact only.
rationale.supplier_concentration_diversification: The supplier-side study cannot measure the company's own purchasing concentration; factual only until a buyer-side, denominator-complete dataset exists.
rationale.new_strategic_relationship: A clearly named relationship may corroborate another source-backed condition, but materiality and company-wide significance are not established by the notice alone.
rationale.persistent_procurement_theme: Repeated independently awarded themes may corroborate another source-backed condition, subject to deduplication and category coverage; they do not independently establish operational change.
